svg.title: AIcoach — Other pages (timeline spine)
svg.text: One idea per screen. Where a page has a swing, its moments stay on the spine; where it has none, the spine says so.
Sign in to see your swings.
Your swings are private to you.

text.tspan: Keep your feet and the clubhead in the

feet are cut off, AIcoach can’t measure
No guess this time. I couldn’t find

svg.text: I read only down the line.
Hips and posture need the whole body.

threshold. That is a real answer.
the trail side at the top.

and saved clip. You can’t sign in again.

svg.text: Email and password. Nothing else on the screen.
Six steps. Each one is a link target from a rejection.
One step, one picture, one sentence of why.

Each row is a tiny spine. You see where it went wrong.
Delete one analysis, or everything. Nothing hidden.
A plain confirm. Dark, not alarming red.
